record.original_question: Fix an integer k > 2. Given a graph G as input, is deciding whether chi*_l(G) <= k complete for the complexity class Pi^P_2?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.10 Fix k > 2. Given a graph G as input, is the problem of deciding whether chi*_l(G) <= k complete for the complexity class Pi^P_2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G=(V,E) be a finite simple graph. A list assignment on G is a function L assigning to each vertex v∈V a finite set L(v) of allowed colors. A proper L-coloring of G is a function f with f(v)∈L(v) for all v∈V and f(u)≠f(v) for every edge uv∈E. For an integer k≥1, an L-packing of size k is a collection {f_1,…,f_k} of proper L-colorings of G such that for all 1≤i<j≤k and all v∈V, f_i(v)≠f_j(v). The list packing number χ*_ℓ(G) is the least integer k such that for every list assignment L with |L(v)|=k for all v∈V, an L-packing of size k exists.

Fix an integer k>2. Consider the decision problem: given a graph G as input, decide whether χ*_ℓ(G)≤k. Determine whether this problem is complete for the complexity class Π^P_2 (the class of languages decidable by a co-nondeterministic polynomial-time machine with access to an NP oracle, i.e., the second universal level of the polynomial hierarchy).
artifact.status_search_result: List packing was introduced around 2021 and is an active area; current literature on the list packing number focuses on combinatorial bounds for graph classes (bounded degree, planar, sparse). No published result establishing Π^P_2-completeness (or membership in a lower class) for deciding χ*_ℓ(G)≤k for fixed k>2 was found, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: List packing number of bounded degree graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies combinatorial upper bounds on the list packing number for graphs of bounded maximum degree, without addressing computational complexity classification.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work focuses on combinatorial bounds for χ*_ℓ rather than its complexity, supporting that the Π^P_2 question is not yet resolved.

status_evidence.title: A Short Proof that the List Packing Number of any Graph is Well Defined
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes that χ*_ℓ(G) is finite for every graph G; foundational result with no complexity classification.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational results on list packing concern existence/bounds, with no Π^P_2-completeness result known.
